name: Ebola & haemorrhagic fevers
summary: DR Congo Ebola outbreak reaches 10,741 confirmed cases and 5,230 deaths; Kenya and Nigeria affected in October
state: ECDC reported on 6 Nov that DR Congo had 10,741 confirmed cases and 5,230 related deaths as of 5 Nov, with community transmission ongoing across eight provinces. Kenya confirmed its first case on 6 Oct and had nine cases, including two deaths, by 26 Oct; Nigeria reported a case on 20 Oct (ECDC).
for_you: The risk is concentrated in affected areas of DR Congo and neighbouring countries. Travellers can check FCDO travel advice and UKHSA guidance; anyone returning from affected areas with symptoms can follow NHS and UKHSA advice.
rubric_hit: Alert: 10,741 confirmed cases > 1,000 line; Nigeria (20 Oct) newly affected within past 30 days
basis_detail: WHO, Africa CDC and ECDC case counts
basis_by: WHO, Africa CDC and ECDC case counts

why: Ebola, Marburg and similar viruses kill a large share of those infected; outbreaks that reach cities or cross borders can overwhelm health systems.
drivers: Surveillance and contact tracing, vaccine availability (none licensed for some strains), conflict, cross-border travel, health-worker infections.

rubric.alert: More than 1,000 cases, or spread to a new country in the past 30 days.
rubric.watch: An active outbreak contained within one country, or fewer than 1,000 cases.
rubric.normal: No active Ebola/Marburg outbreak, or outbreaks declining with no new countries affected in 60 days.
